svg.title: Resonate application architecture
svg.desc: Application-level view of Resonate: human, desktop and agent surfaces call one NestJS modular backend organised into bounded contexts, which delegates to Demucs, Stable Audio, agent-runtime and analytics workers, persists to Postgres, Redis, object storage, Pub/Sub and BigQuery, and transacts through ERC-4337 smart accounts, Resonate protocol contracts and x402 USDC settlement.

svg.text: One catalog, three surfaces, a modular NestJS backend, asynchronous AI media workers and on-chain commerce.
